segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's minetn entry) to Minetown. This independently chosen seed exercises mkmaze.c fixup_special(): the loaded level's town flag becomes svl.level.flags.has_town before check_special_room() tests in_town() and records the one-time Mine Town achievement.
